{{Top|leg}}
The '''tank beast''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] war creature. Massive and armored, it had large clawed legs and was able to project both flame and acid from its mouth. One was sent against [[Ganner Rhysode]] during the [[Battle of the World-Well]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], but Rhysode killed it by bringing the ceiling down on it.
